notes: WON'T OPEN / "Failed to load Python DLL": if Dezzy sits in OneDrive (your Desktop usually is), OneDrive empties the app's files out to save space and it stops opening even though you never touched it. The download now has 'INSTALL - Double-click me first.bat', which installs Dezzy somewhere OneDrive can't reach and makes your shortcut, plus 'FIX IT - Run if Dezzy wont open.bat', which tells you exactly what's wrong and repairs it. Dezzy also warns you if it's running from a cloud folder. CLOSING ACTUALLY CLOSES: Dezzy could stay running in Task Manager after you closed the window, so you had to End Task before reopening it. It now releases the sound devices first, takes the overlay and pop-ups with it, and force-quits anyway if anything hangs. Minimised Dezzy also stops its background checks while you can't see it. MIC + SOUNDS STAYS ON: on by default, and it looks after itself. No saved mic? It picks one. Mic unplugged or died mid-stream? It checks every 3 seconds, tells you on screen, and switches back on the moment you plug it in. It will never quietly move you to a different microphone - you'd end up streaming into the wrong one without knowing. ADDING SOUNDS FROM A LINK: works again - the downloader was never actually included in the app, and sites behind Cloudflare now get a real browser handshake instead of a 403. You can see it working too: a real progress bar with percentage, speed and time left, and it always clears itself when it finishes or fails. STORE SEARCH: works again - Myinstants shut off the API it used, so search found nothing for every word. It reads their live search page now, and Load more brings new sounds instead of repeating. UPDATES CAN'T DELETE YOUR FILES: if you kept Dezzy on your Desktop or in Downloads, an update used to mirror that whole folder and wipe your shortcut and other files. Fixed. The update bar now shows from the banner too, and a failed update can be closed and retried instead of blocking the button until you restart. VOICE CHANGER: the on/off switch is gone - move Pitch or Tone, or pick a voice, and it turns itself on. Saved voices actually switch from a hotkey or a spoken word, even when the changer isn't running yet. You can't save an empty voice by accident any more - that was the real reason a saved voice's hotkey seemed to do nothing. Each saved voice now shows what it does. SETTING THINGS IN TWO PLACES: several things could be set from two screens that saved to two different files, so setting it in one never showed in the other. A voice's hotkey had two panels. A word set on a Screen never became a real trigger, and screen hotkeys never activated until you restarted. A multi-sound hotkey showed as blank and got wiped if you retyped it. A multi-sound alert event got destroyed by the Discord dropdown. All fixed. MUSIC: queue songs you ALREADY have instead of only pasting links - hit '+ My music', search, add. Saved playlists take your own music the same way and can be reordered. A Clear all button (it asks once first), and up/down ordering on the phone too. Shuffle, loop and the headphone button no longer glow when they're off, the play button shows a play arrow when nothing's playing, and the bar dims when music is off. 0.5x-2x speed with pitch kept, and the volume keeps rising instead of clipping. VOICE QUALITY: pitch shifts land within 1 cent at every setting, no more phasey or robotic Natural mode, tone changes character without moving your pitch, no static under load, and every effect is level-matched so switching doesn't jump in loudness. IT NEVER OPENED AT ALL: if you double-clicked Dezzy and nothing ever appeared, that's fixed. On a PC without the Microsoft WebView2 runtime the window couldn't open and the app quietly shut itself down instead of falling back. It now opens in your browser instead, and if even that fails it tells you why rather than vanishing. You also get a loading screen straight away, so the gap between double-clicking and the window appearing isn't a blank screen any more. MINIMISING: minimising Dezzy could leave it frozen when you brought it back - it looked normal but clicking did nothing, and clicking away and back only fixed some of it. Fixed. THE LOADING LOGO: the logo shown while Dezzy starts had a purple outline around it. That was the loading screen's doing, not the artwork - it fills see-through areas with magenta and then hides the magenta again, which leaves a coloured fringe on anything with soft edges. The logo now floats cleanly: no outline, no box behind it. FASTER: the camera libraries were loading on every launch even if you never use camera reactions - about a second saved. Also fixed: a change meant to speed up the first button press was re-routing your audio output on startup, which is what made the soundboard almost inaudible. It's gone - the sound engine was already warmed up before it anyway. ALSO: quick keys for pause music / mute mic / clear GIFs, mobile tab bar with nothing cut off, mic auto-picked, and a paid licence never locks you out offline.
